velocity.loc_breakdown_note: Single-day sprint. Direct mirror of std/gzip shape (v0.12.0 precedent: ~500 LOC). Go's compress/flate and compress/zlib provide all four primitives natively, so no new architecture. Breakdown: ~250 LOC builtins + ~150 LOC tests (M1) + ~30 LOC stdlib wrapper (M2) + ~30 LOC example + ~20 LOC CHANGELOG/doc updates (M3).

features.description: Create internal/builtins/deflate.go with four registered builtins (_deflate_inflate, _deflate_inflateZlib, _deflate_deflate, _deflate_deflateZlib) backed by Go's compress/flate and compress/zlib. Apply 100MB decompressed-size cap mirroring std/gzip. Wire into RegisterAll. Write deflate_test.go covering round-trip, cross-format negative, malformed input, output cap, and level-monotonicity tests.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip: inflate(deflate(x, level)) == x for level in {0, 1, 6, 9, -1}
Round-trip: inflateZlib(deflateZlib(x, level)) == x for the same levels
Cross-format negative: inflate(deflateZlib(x, 6)) returns Err (zlib header confuses raw deflate)
Malformed base64/deflate input returns typed Err, no panic
Output cap test: hand-built stream decompressing past 100MB returns Err
Level monotonicity: deflate(input, 9) size <= deflate(input, 1) size for non-trivial input
features.notes: deflate.go (363 LOC) + deflate_test.go (340 LOC). All 18 deflate tests pass. Updated builtin_types.golden (288 signatures). Lint clean.

features.description: Create std/deflate.ail with module declaration, import std/result, and four exported pure func declarations matching the std/gzip.ail shape exactly. Doc-comments must explain the raw vs zlib-wrapped pairs and call out concrete use cases (PDF FlateDecode -> use inflateZlib; raw deflate streams -> use inflate). Verify stdlib loader picks it up.
acceptance_criteria: std/deflate.ail exports inflate, inflateZlib, deflate, deflateZlib as pure func
Module loads without error: ailang on a one-liner that imports std/deflate resolves
Doc-comments include 'use inflateZlib for PDF/HTTP, inflate for raw deflate' guidance
features.notes: std/deflate.ail (~60 LOC) — embed picks it up via existing //go:embed *.ail glob. Verified end-to-end with round-trip program: deflateZlib + inflateZlib preserves input.
